# Open a Settings page (`settings.open`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Apps & scripts · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** no

Opens a Windows Settings page, for settings that should be changed by hand.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | one of: `display`, `night_light`, `sound`, `notifications`, `focus`, `power`, `battery`, `bluetooth`, `wifi`, `network`, `personalization`, `background`, `colors`, `taskbar`, `mouse`, `keyboard`, `language`, `date_time`, `apps`, `default_apps`, `storage`, `privacy`, `windows_update`, `about` | yes |  | Which page. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: settings.open
    page: display
```
